what: Manual precision audit of the entity linker on a random sample of linked documents from the replay corpus (seeded sample, spam excluded).
judged_by: the author, with AI assistance (no second annotator)
note: Identity = the alias really refers to that company. Incidental = correct company but not the subject of the item. Analyst-note incidentals are removed by the routine-item gate before event formation. Sample of 70 gives only a wide interval: identity precision lower 95% bound is about 95%.
script: see docs/EVALUATION.md (sample drawn with random.seed(11) over non-spam corpus documents that contain at least one link)
